subject: input
reference lead: rows arrive in source order with a target total
bytes: rows come from a user to weight tree, are stable sorted by weight, largest first, and each row is rescaled to trunc(f64(w)/f64(sum)*f64(target)) before any remainder rule

subject: floor
bytes: a row whose amount is under the floor argument is dropped; the payout passes floor 0, so zero rows stay

subject: leftover
reference lead: added to rows[0] in source order
bytes: added to the largest kept row; overflow gives tag 0xbe with no text

subject: excess
reference lead: row reduced by at most floor(row*factor)
bytes: the same limit, then the walk stops at the first row whose limit covers what is left

subject: bad factor
bytes: no separate error: a NaN, negative or above 1.01 factor skips the walk and reports the remainder

subject: errors
reference lead: EmptyDistribution, Overflow and Underflow enum values
bytes: tag 0xfa with an owned text, five texts in all, and tag 0xbe for one overflow

subject: payout
bytes: each row needs try_hold on the sentinel's token 0 row; the first refusal ends the loop with Ok and the users paid so far

subject: notional
bytes: the payout moves total and hold only; the sentinel row's third word stays, and neither side is valued
